svg.title: Phase 3 wiring: ESP32-P4 board, XIAO ESP32-S3, BNO085, OV5647 and LiPo
svg.desc: P4 header pin 1 5V to XIAO 5V, pin 5 GND to XIAO GND, XIAO D6 to pin 11 GPIO5, pin 14 GPIO4 to XIAO D7; BNO085 VIN to pin 2, SDA to pin 4, SCL to pin 6, GND to pin 10; optional R4 beeper through shifter channel 3.
svg.text: Phase 3 wiring: ESP32-P4 4.3" board + XIAO + BNO085 IMU + camera (planned, firmware not written)
Pin-to-pin. P4, XIAO and BNO085 are all 3.3 V logic: direct wires, no shifter. Header numbering is Waveshare's (pin 1 = 5V), NOT Raspberry Pi's.
rear view (screen faces away), 3.3 V logic
header rows drawn spread apart for the labels (real pitch 2.54 mm); pin 1 = square pad
Or use a STEMMA QT to female-socket
15-pin 0.5 mm ribbon (NOT the 1.0 mm RPi one)
Red = + to J2 pin 1, black = GND to pin 2.
CHECK with a meter before plugging in:
cheap cells come wired both ways.
OPTIONAL: keep the R4 as a beeper (P4 -> R4 only, through channel 3 of the Phase 2 level shifter)
Wire list (F-F jumpers; O4-O6 need M ends at the R4)
XIAO talks to the P4, not the R4.
